project_scope_derivation.note: Node 01 is limited to AlphaFold3 and ESMFold2 as scientific tools. Intranet deployment does not restrict locally deployed AlphaFold3/ESMFold2; it only removes external database queries. Existing S-07 RCSB/BLAST/UniProt/AFDB retrieval evidence remains historical only.

contract_consolidation.task: Consolidate the confirmed input baseline and dispersed expert rules into one reviewable request contract.
expert_evidence: Phase-1 flowchart: target protein sequence + host species; design objective/expression host optional
AgentA Schema: protein_sequence and host_species fields
S-07c/structure-chain ToolSpec: optional local PDB/CIF/mmCIF input, optional chain, preserve original format, parse failure and missing-atom warning
R-58: sequence-to-structure alignment and chain/residue mapping before structure-dependent tools
contract_consolidation.escalation_policy: Engineering resolves naming, transport, hashing and idempotency. Escalate only a concrete conflict or true scientific gap to the appropriate expert; do not ask the user to redefine documented rules.
contract_consolidation.temporary_boundary: Accept the confirmed required sequence and host species plus optional local structure; never resolve accession or missing data through external database queries.
